page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 2 vCPUs, operating at 1 thread per core. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not feature any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth for this instance is rated at 1 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance serves as an entry-level GPU resource, offering dedicated compute cores and hardware acceleration without the overhead of massive memory arrays or local storage. It is designed for workloads that require GPU acceleration on a budget, such as small-scale AI inference, video transcoding, and lightweight graphics rendering.
